svg.title: VIGIL-88, incident detection that reasons across time
svg.desc: Plate V. The title VIGIL-88, drawn as exact construction geometry: public code, built through P6 with a desktop console. Three lanes along one time axis. Capture: frames arrive one after another, each a solid mark. Detector: each frame is answered by a ring, empty or holding a detection. Evidence: a solid line accumulates toward a verified event and a durable incident. Below, a dashed line for what is not measured: detection accuracy, and fire and smoke, which are declared absent. An ember marks the latest frame. A frame is evidence, not a verdict.
